value.value: The list contains active feature names from cargo metadata --locked for the artifact generator. The source digest includes sdk, but this command does not compile sdk.
The issuer and revocation add positive native_use_sum terms to their claims. These terms are not AIR RelationEntry calls.
HashStreamV1.streamId is the absorb stream ID. `streamIds` also contains the separate squeeze stream IDs.
One entry exists for each drawn relation instance. The value is the tuple width. Private witness data determines the nonzero occurrence count.
After tree 1, mix claims in physical AIR order. ML-DSA roles mix group_evals before claimed_sums.

Mix the PCS configuration and commit tree0. Mix 20 AIR public statements and commit tree1. Draw the secure fields in challengeOrder. Mix claims in physical AIR order and commit tree2. Run the shared_keccak_service GKR post-interaction and commit tree3. Then calculate the composition polynomial and FRI.
All relation tuple coordinates use M31. Each executable RelationEntry coordinate is a base-field value. AIR constraints and lookup domains enforce narrower byte, bit, and range rules.
